newsitem.title: USA: Federal Express introduces on-line service.
newsitem.headline: Federal Express introduces on-line service.

text.p: Federal Express Corp on Wednesday introduced a new Internet-based service allowing companies to make on-line orders.
The service, called FedEx BusinessLink, is already available to charter customers and will be rolled out nationally in early 1997, the company said.

FedEx BusinessLink includes software for businesses to create and update their own on-line catalog and will allow them to search for products around the world, check pricing and place orders via FedEx BusinessLink, Federal Express said.
